question.problem: If $\operatorname{cot}⁡x=-4$ for some $x,$ then find the value of $3\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+17\pi )+6.$
question.worked_solution:
The period of $y=\operatorname{cot}⁡x$ is $\pi .$ Therefore, for any integer $n,$ we have

$$
\operatorname{cot}⁡x=\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+n\pi ).
$$

Substituting $n=17$ into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cot}⁡x & =\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+17\cdot \pi ) \\  & =\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+17\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\operatorname{cot}⁡x=-4,$ then $\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+17\pi )=-4.$

Finally, then

$$
\begin{aligned}3\operatorname{cot}⁡(x+7\pi )+6 & =3(-4)+6 \\  & =-12+6 \\  & =-6.\end{aligned}
$$
